subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FintechCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FintechCorp

Hi Alex / Priya -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our demo and a proposed POC plan so your team can review and share with the stakeholders we discussed. I pasted the high-level timeline and ownership below and attached a one-page outline.

Demo highlights
- Inference flow: Redwood API -> model selection -> caching/quantization options we demoed.
- Performance: ~25ms median token latency on the demo config, batching reduces cost.
- Security: VPC/private deploy options, KMS integration, audit logs.

Proposed POC objective
Goal: Validate Redwood's hosted inference for FintechCorp's claims summarization pipeline and measure latency/cost tradeoffs while validating data controls.

Success criteria (initial suggestions)
1) Quality: system reaches >85% mark-to-human agreement on the summary test-set (50 sample tickets).
2) Latency: median end-to-end response under 1500ms for 95% of requests with target concurrency of 20 RPS.
3) Cost: per-request inference cost within the forecasted range (we'll provide modeled numbers).
4) Security/compliance: SSO + SOC2 evidence accepted by your InfoSec and all logs retained per your retention policy.

Scope & timeline
- Week 0 (alignment): Sign SOW + finalize success criteria (you) - target by Apr 8.
- Week 1 (kickoff): Integration and dataset handoff (SE + TAM) - target week of Apr 11.
- Week 2-3: Run evaluation, iterate prompts, measure latency/cost.
- Week 4: Review results and decision.

Ownership
- Redwood AE: Marissa Cole (project lead / commercial).
- Redwood SE: Rishi Malhotra (integration, benchmarks).
- Redwood TAM: Monica Patel (onboarding & monitoring).
- FintechCorp PM: Alex Johnson (POC lead), Priya Shah (InfoSec point).

Next steps
1) Confirm success criteria or propose edits by EOD Friday (Apr 1).
2) Sign the attached SOW draft (we can DocuSign).
3) Proposed kickoff week of Apr 11 - confirm availability.

Attachments: FintechCorp_POC-outline.pdf (1-page outline)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345678
DocuSign (SOW draft): https://www.docusign.com/12345

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FintechCorp

Marissa -

Appreciate the thorough recap and the outline. Quick notes from our side after reviewing with Priya:

- Success criteria: the >85% agreement on summaries sounds right, but we'd like to add a precision/recall check on a smaller labeled subset for the first run (say 20 documents) so we can see if the model is systematically dropping specific entities.
- Latency: the 1500ms target is okay, but can you confirm the breakdown (model inference vs network vs your SDK overhead)? We need the numbers disaggregated for our infra team.
- Security: Priya asked whether SSO is supported for the console and whether we can get a SOC2 Type II report and a list of sub-processors ahead of legal review.
- Data handling: during the POC, we will send user tickets (sampled) with masked PII; after integration we'll evaluate a small real stream. Can you confirm retention defaults and whether we can request logs be retained for 90 days?

We are generally aligned but need clarity on the SOW around termination and data deletion timelines. Also, who will be the day-to-day contact for integration questions?

If you can answer the above, we can confirm the kickoff week of Apr 11; Priya & I are available Apr 12-14 for the initial session.

Thanks,
Alex
Product Manager, FintechCorp
alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com | +1 212 555 0133

Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FintechCorp

Thanks Alex - great questions. Answers below and a few pragmatic edits to the plan so we can move forward: 

1) Metrics disaggregation: absolutely - Rishi will run the benchmarks and provide a breakdown: model inference, network, SDK/client overhead. We'll publish a short table in the results deliverable.

2) Precision/recall test: happy to add the 20-doc labeled subset check into week 2 as you requested. We'll include entity-level metrics.

3) SSO & SOC2: SSO via SAML is supported for the Redwood Console; we'll include technical steps in the kickoff. We will provide our SOC2 Type II report and sub-processor list for legal review (I've attached the SOW and will share the SOC2 link once legal confirms permissions).

4) Retention & deletion: default retention during the POC is 90 days for logs and payloads; we can shorten on request and we will document the deletion process in the SOW.

5) Day-to-day contact: Rishi (cc'd) will own integration and benchmarks; Monica (cc'd) will own monitoring, dashboards, and runbook handoff. I'll remain the commercial lead and coordinate deliverables and success criteria sign-off.

Proposed tweak to timeline: asking FintechCorp to confirm success criteria by Apr 4; sign SOW by Apr 7; kickoff week Apr 11 (we can lock in Apr 12 as the technical kickoff if that works).

Action items
- Alex/Priya: confirm the small edits to success criteria + availability for Apr 12 kickoff.
- Marissa: send updated SOW in DocuSign and attach SOC2 link once available.
- Rishi: prepare benchmark plan and data ingestion checklist.

Rishi - can you reply and confirm you'll take point on the integration tasks and share an ETA for the benchmark plan doc?

Thanks,
Marissa
